launch_parameters.launchId: [A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}; unique per invocation, including process restarts
launch_parameters.seedIds: JSON array of unique real positive integer contact IDs, at least 205 for the full suite
launch_parameters.queryKey: one actual seed lookup key only for query-no-read

authority: Only root may build, sign, install, seed through real public CRUD, interact with QEMU/UI and wire shared suite/closure. This HAP records raw observations and has no pass decision.
journal_context: getApplicationContext().filesDir; public queryContact retains original UIAbilityContext
provider_identity: exact preinstalled system singleton account0 BMS tuple; actual AMS provider PID/UID and account100 host binding required
